# Introduction

Substantive prose with *emphasis*, **strong** text and `inline code`,
plus one retained [safe reference](https://example.com/notation).

Measurement notes:

- inspect the setup before recording
- correct unsafe conditions immediately
- record the ambient conditions

## Method

The procedure is deliberately boring: prepare, measure, record, repeat.

title: Readable mathematics

# Mathematics

A numbered equation and a numbered derivation, both written in readable
notation rather than LaTeX.

:::: equation
id: gaussian-integral
number: true
----
integral x=-infinity..infinity of exp(-x^2) dx = sqrt(pi)
::::

:::: derivation
id: geometric-series
number: true
----
- expression: S_n = sum i=0..n of r^i
  annotation: partial sum of the first n + 1 powers
- expression: r * S_n = sum i=1..n+1 of r^i
  annotation: multiply every term by r
- expression: S_n - r * S_n = 1 - r^(n+1)
  annotation: subtraction telescopes the interior terms
- expression: S_n = (1 - r^(n+1)) / (1 - r)
  annotation: closed form, valid for r != 1
::::

source:

azemark: 2
title: RC step response
---

# RC step response

An analytic curve and measured points with uncertainties in one coordinate
system. Samples in undefined regions gap; error bars render.

:::: plot
id: rc-step-response
number: true
parameters:
  V0: 5
  R: 1000
  C: 1e-6
x-axis:
  label: time (s)
  min: 0
  max: 0.005
y-axis:
  label: voltage (V)
  min: 0
----
- kind: function
  label: analytic step response
  variable: t
  expression: V0 * (1 - exp(-t / (R * C)))
  domain:
    min: 0
    max: 0.005
  samples: 400
- kind: scatter
  label: measured points
  points:
    - x: 0.0005
      y: 1.99
      error: 0.08
    - x: 0.001
      y: 3.11
      error: 0.10
    - x: 0.002
      y: 4.36
      error-low: 0.14
      error-high: 0.09
    - x: 0.003
      y: 4.71
      error: 0.12
::::
